name: SMSAPI
description: Drupal integration with the SMSAPI.com / smsapi.pl SMS gateway: an admin UI and a reusable service for sending single and bulk SMS, reusable message templates, MFA verification codes, and delivery-report callbacks.
library_dependencies: smsapi/php-client ^3.0 (official SMSAPI PHP SDK; provides the SmsapiClient, region services, and the SMS / MFA / Profile feature bags this module wraps)
project_description: SMSAPI provides Drupal integration with the SMSAPI.com SMS gateway (regional endpoints for Poland, international .com, Sweden and Bulgaria). It ships an admin configuration form for the OAuth API token, region, test/production environment, mock mode and Partner ID; an admin 'Send SMS' and 'Send SMS with template' form; a SMSAPI Profile page showing account data; and a 'SMSAPI SMS Template' config entity for reusable, tokenised messages. The core piece is the injectable smsapi.service (SmsapiService), which developers call to send single or bulk SMS, send templated SMS, send and verify MFA/2FA codes, list active sender names, and fetch profile data via the official smsapi/php-client SDK. A GET /smsapi/callback route records SMSAPI delivery reports into the Drupal log.
